source_locator: R2232: ch. 3, The Thirteenth Air Force
current_activity: air force headquarters established on Espiritu Santo
notes: Craven and Cate, vol. IV, ch. 3: on 13 January 1943 General Harmon activated the Thirteenth Air Force and General Nathan F. Twining established his headquarters on Espiritu Santo, adjacent to Admiral Fitch. The place used is Pekoa Airfield as the representative Espiritu Santo air-base point; the headquarters itself was ashore next to COMAIRSOPAC, not necessarily on the runway. Precision is widened to 10 km. Confidence 0.5.
